summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified via browser checks. Registration modal shows exactly one top-right X close button (default Radix close button disabled via showCloseButton={false}, only custom DialogClose remains), it dismisses the modal on click, and it has an accessible name ('Close registration picker') and can receive keyboard focus.

checks.criterion: Registration modal displays exactly one close control
checks.name: registration-modal-single-close-button
checks.evidence: Opened modal via hero Register Now button; getByTestId('registration-modal-close-button') resolved to exactly 1 visible element (toHaveCount(1) + toBeVisible passed). Source confirms DialogContent showCloseButton={false} removes the default Radix close button, leaving only the custom DialogClose.

checks.criterion: The remaining close control dismisses the modal
checks.name: registration-modal-close-dismisses
checks.evidence: Clicked registration-modal-close-button; modal (data-testid=registration-game-picker-modal) transitioned to not visible, assertion passed.

checks.name: registration-modal-close-accessible
checks.evidence: getByRole('button', { name: /close registration picker/i }) resolved and was visible (sr-only span 'Close registration picker' provides accessible name); .focus() + toBeFocused() confirmed keyboard focusability.
